purchases.no_company: Choose a company to see its purchase orders.
purchases.read_only: You may read purchase orders, not change them.
purchases.received_part: The receipt is recorded; the rest is still expected.
purchases.received_all: The receipt is recorded; the whole order is received.

fixed_notes.sent: Sent to the vendor: it no longer changes. Receive the goods when they arrive, or cancel it while nothing is received.
fixed_notes.partly_received: Part of it is received: receive the rest when it arrives, or close the order if the rest will not come.
fixed_notes.closed: Closed: the rest is no longer expected.
fixed_notes.cancelled: Cancelled: nothing is expected from it.

errors.not_found: This order does not exist, or no longer does.
errors.conflict: The order changed state meanwhile: reload the page to see where it stands.
errors.invalid: The order was not accepted: check what is marked.
errors.vendor_unavailable: This vendor is retired: choose another.

form.expected_hint: The day the vendor is to deliver.
form.remarks_hint: For the vendor, with the order.
form.notes_hint: For the company only: never shown to the vendor.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description_hint: The product's name to start with; write it as the vendor should read it.

errors.quantity: A positive quantity, three decimals at most.
errors.unitPriceNet: A price, four decimals at most.

actions.send_message: It gets its number and no longer changes. While nothing is received, it can still be cancelled.
actions.close_message: The rest is no longer expected: the order is closed with what was received.
actions.cancel_message: Nothing more will be expected or received from it.

receive.title: Receive the goods
receive.reference_hint: The number of the vendor's delivery note.

day_problems.day: Write the day the goods arrived.
day_problems.before: Goods arrive on the day the order was sent at the earliest.
day_problems.after: Goods are received once they arrived: today at the latest.

problems.quantity: A positive quantity, three decimals at most.
problems.over: At most {{expected}} {{unit}}: that is what is still expected.
problems.lot: This product is tracked by lot: write the lot.
problems.lot_length: A lot is 40 characters at most.
problems.serials_repeated: The same serial number is written twice.
problems.serial_length: A serial number is 40 characters at most.
problems.unit_cost: A cost, four decimals at most.
